newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Pakistani for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Pakistani man for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, raising to 48 the number of executions in the country this year, the Saudi Interior Ministry said.
A ministry statement carried by Saudi state television said the man was executed in the western Jeddah region after being found guilty of smuggling an unspecified amount of heroin into the country.
Conservative Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
